## Summary

Fixed duplicate hook execution in Cursor. Cursor loads hooks from both `.cursor/hooks.json` and `.claude/settings.json`, causing hooks to run twice (once as `cursor-chat`, once as `claude-code`).

**Solution:**
- Modified `generateClaudeCodeConfig` in `semio-repo/cli/main.go` to check if `.cursor/hooks.json` exists
- If it exists, skip generating hooks in `.claude/settings.json` to prevent duplication
- Preserve other settings (permissions, etc.) in `.claude/settings.json`
- Added tests to verify the behavior

**Result:**
- Hooks are removed from `.claude/settings.json` when Cursor hooks are present
- Hooks now execute only once (as `cursor-chat`) instead of twice
- Permissions and other settings in `.claude/settings.json` are preserved

The fix is complete and tested. Hooks will no longer execute twice in Cursor.
